author: Jon Hamilton
title: GLP-1s have transformed weight loss and diabetes. Is addiction next?
description: A large study found that people taking GLP-1 drugs like Ozempic for diabetes were less likely to be diagnosed with substance use disorder.
content:
There's new evidence that GLP-1 drugs like Ozempic can reduce the risk of addiction.
